overflowLinks._why: Item 3c: "(specify, using extra sheet if necessary)". Rule the-packet-uses-mc025-for-more-space: what the two lines cannot print continues on MC-025. The paper prints no box that says a sheet is attached, so the link has no marks.
Rule the-packet-uses-mc025-for-more-space: item 8a asks for the reasons on a separate sheet, and no box on FL-155 holds them - the whole answer is an MC-025 page.

overflowLinks._whySheetFor: The 8a box itself says "(specify reasons for expenses on separate sheet)"; this MC-025 page is that sheet. sheetFor tells the audit (RULE 13) which box the page serves, without the form ticking or unticking it - the box is the filer's own answer.

overflowLinks._why: Rule the-packet-uses-mc025-for-more-space: item 12 says to attach an extra sheet with the information, and no box on FL-155 holds it - the whole answer is an MC-025 page.

computedFields._why: The caption's ATTORNEY FOR (Name) is the filer's name when a lawyer represents them, and blank when the filer has no lawyer. DV-100's "Do you have a lawyer?" ticks has_lawyer_yes.

The PETITIONER/PLAINTIFF box under the signature says who signs, and the filer asking for protection is the petitioner. It ticks on DV-100's "Child support" order, the answer that brings FL-155 into the packet, so every FL-155 filer has it. The respondent box beside it is split into a field of its own by the sanitizer.
The other parent's share of the children's time is what is left of 100 after the filer's: the two numbers the paper prints always add up.

alwaysShown.question: fl155_custody_arrangement_line_1

alwaysShown.question: fl155_applied_public_assistance

alwaysShown.question: fl155_tax_status

alwaysShown.question: fl155_monthly_expense_kinds
